title: Owner decides where generated backlog views live
goal: The owner picks how generated views are built, published and linked before any project changes
acceptance: The owner chooses an option (or amends one) on the decision page, with the transition length
The decision and date are recorded on the page and in F-096
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories and records; no personal data.
escalation: No view stops being committed before this decision

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: reading one page with four options. Not a measurement.
